_source: Verbatim Thai i18n consumed by OpexBudget (pototype/opex-budget.jsx OpexBudget L44-183 + the detail/create modals). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so NO Thai/baht literal sits in opex-budget.tsx / opex-budget-form.tsx — same pattern as land-bank-strings.json + ap-deposit-strings.json. Every value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, en-dash U+2013, baht U+0E3F). Values in _present already resolve in i18n-full.json.phrases and are consumed via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (lang=th, tp() returns the key itself) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are staged for the Wei-approved i18n round in agents/orch-b-recon/opex-i18n.apply.json (B-248). DICT keys (org.unitDept / common.export / common.save / common.cancel / common.close / common.total) are consumed via t() directly, not this file. THIN-HONEST port (B-246 = ข, Wei-ruled): render only the backend-backed opex_budget fields {dept, year, months[12]}; every un-backed prototype element (used / committed / remaining / %used / cats / plan-vs-actual chart / multi-year view) is honest-em-dashed or disabled.
